title: 第12章 毒蚕豆，孙友文上门
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
梁心兰给陆林处理了伤口。

    也没有多说话就离开。

    出门的时候，她脸上红扑扑的，却刻意板着脸。

    一夜无话。

    第二天一早起来。

    陆林摸了摸受伤的地方，已经结痂，估计有个三五天就差不多能好。

    梁心兰早上蒸了些獐子肉。

    昨天还挺好吃的，可今天吃起来，感觉有些不对劲。

    陆林也不懂厨艺。

    吃过饭后就去院子里练习箭术。

    【箭术：登堂入室（16/1000）】

    实战中，箭术经验涨得快。

    可是山里没有那么多动物。

    陆林又换上了自己的三力弓和木箭。

    铎，铎，铎。

    木箭中靶的声音不绝于耳。

    原本还需要十三四次才能增加一点经验。

    今天陆林射出十箭，就能增加一点。

    这么算下来，还要拉弓上万次才能升级。

    木箭便宜。

    可以就地取材。

    若是用铁箭，陆林可舍不得这么浪费。

    一上午的时间很快过去。

    陆林的箭术经验接近八十。

    “嫂嫂，你先弄肉，我去借点粮。”

    “你的伤还没……”

    “没事，嫂嫂治伤的手艺，一晚上就好的差不多了。”

    梁心兰忍不住又想起昨晚给陆林涂药的经历，脸上一红，自顾自进了厨房。

    陆林进屋拿了那根豹腿骨，出门直奔陆大勇家。

    也不敲门，直接进去。

    正好看到陆大勇在熬粥。

    “大勇叔，你认得这是什么吗？”

    陆大勇接过腿骨一看，脸色巨变。

    “你遇到啦？”

    “啊？”

    “不对不对，你应该没有遇到。”

    陆大勇松了口气。

    陆林好奇追问。

    原来，这种变黑的骨头，在齐梁山并不是个例。

    在山中讨生活的猎户，基本都遇到过几次。

    野兽受伤后，都会自己找办法治疗。

    有的野兽运气好，能吃到草药。

    也有运气不好的，就会吃到毒蚕豆。

    毒蚕豆大约有人的拇指那么大。

    果实乌黑，发亮，会散发出一阵阵清香的药味。

    吃下后确实可以治伤。

    还能强壮骨骼。

    但是。

    这时间短还好，过上三五个月，毒蚕豆中的毒素就会扩展到全身。

    到时候，全身上下的骨头都变成黑色。

    到这一步，那就代表没救了。
content_en:
Liang Xinlan treated Lu Lin's wounds.

    He left without saying much.

    When she went out, her face was flushed, but she deliberately kept a straight face.

    A night of silence.

    Get up early the next morning.

    Lu Lin touched the injured area and found scabs forming. It would probably be almost healed in three to five days.

    Liang Xinlan steamed some deer meat in the morning.

    It was quite delicious yesterday, but when I tasted it today, I felt something was wrong.

    Lu Lin doesn't know how to cook either.

    After dinner, we went to the yard to practice archery.

    [Archery: Entering the House (16/1000)]

    In actual combat, archery experience increases quickly.

    But there are not so many animals in the mountains.

    Lu Lin put on his three-power bow and wooden arrows again.

    Duo, Duo, Duo.

    The sound of wooden arrows hitting the target was endless.

    Originally, it would take thirteen or four times to gain a little experience.

    If Lu Lin shoots ten arrows today, he can gain a little more.

    After all, it would take tens of thousands of bow pulls to level up.

    Wooden arrows are cheap.

    You can use local materials.

    If iron arrows were used, Lu Lin would not be willing to waste them.

    The morning passed quickly.

    Lu Lin's archery experience is close to eighty.

    "Sister-in-law, you get the meat first, and I'll borrow some grain."

    "You're not injured yet..."

    "It's okay. With my sister-in-law's skills in healing injuries, it will be almost healed in one night."

    Liang Xinlan couldn't help but remember the experience of applying medicine to Lu Lin last night. Her face turned red and she went into the kitchen.

    Lu Lin went into the house and took the leopard leg bone, then went straight to Lu Dayong's house.

    Don't knock on the door, just go in.

    I happened to see Lu Dayong making porridge.

    "Uncle Dayong, do you recognize what this is?"

    Lu Dayong took the leg bone and looked at it, his expression changed drastically.

    "Did you meet him?"

    "Huh?"

    "No, no, you probably haven't encountered it."

    Lu Dayong breathed a sigh of relief.

    Lu Lin asked curiously.

    It turns out that this kind of blackened bones is not unique in Qiliang Mountain.

    The hunters who are seeking a living in the mountains have basically encountered them several times.

    When a beast is injured, it will find a way to treat it on its own.

    Some beasts are lucky enough to eat herbs.

    Some people who are unlucky will eat poisonous broad beans.

    The poison fava bean is about the size of a person's thumb.

    The fruit is black and shiny, and exudes a refreshing medicinal smell.

    It can indeed heal injuries after eating it.

    It also strengthens bones.

    but.

    This time is short, but after three to five months, the toxins in the broad beans will spread throughout the body.

    By then, all the bones in the body will turn black.

    At this point, it means there is no hope.
title_en: Chapter 12 Poison broad beans, Sun Youwen comes to visit
